+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+
+from .formatting import join_options
+
+
+class OptionBadge(t.TypedDict):
+    """The rendered form of an option's spellings for a help card."""
+
+    #: The joined spellings, followed by the metavar if one was given.
+    text: str
+    #: Whether any spelling uses a slash prefix, such as ``/debug``.
+    windows_style: bool
+
+
+def option_badge(
+    spellings: cabc.Sequence[str], metavar: str | None = None
+) -> OptionBadge:
+    """Render an option's spellings as a single badge for a help card.
+
+    Spellings are ordered stably by prefix length: unprefixed names first,
+    then single-character prefixes such as ``-`` or ``/``, then double
+    prefixes such as ``--``. They are joined with ``", "``. The metavar is
+    appended after a space only if both ``spellings`` and ``metavar`` are
+    non-empty.
+
+    :param spellings: The option's spellings, such as ``["--name", "-n"]``.
+    :param metavar: The placeholder for the option's value, such as
+        ``"TEXT"``.
+    :return: A dict with the rendered ``text`` and a ``windows_style`` flag
+        that is true if any spelling has a slash prefix.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 8.3
+    """
+    text, windows_style = join_options(spellings)
+
+    if text and metavar:
+        text = f"{text} {metavar}"
+
+    return {"text": text, "windows_style": windows_style}

+++ b/tests/test_option_badge.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.option_badge import option_badge
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("spellings", "metavar", "expect"),
+    [
+        ([], None, {"text": "", "windows_style": False}),
+        ([], "TEXT", {"text": "", "windows_style": False}),
+        (["--name"], None, {"text": "--name", "windows_style": False}),
+        (["--name"], "", {"text": "--name", "windows_style": False}),
+        (["--name", "-n"], "TEXT", {"text": "-n, --name TEXT", "windows_style": False}),
+        (
+            ["--verbose", "-v", "verbose", "-V"],
+            None,
+            {"text": "verbose, -v, -V, --verbose", "windows_style": False},
+        ),
+        (
+            ["/debug", "--debug"],
+            None,
+            {"text": "/debug, --debug", "windows_style": True},
+        ),
+        (("+w", "-w"), "N", {"text": "+w, -w N", "windows_style": False}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_option_badge(spellings, metavar, expect):
+    assert option_badge(spellings, metavar) == expect
notes:
Added src/click/option_badge.py, which reuses click.formatting.join_options for stable prefix-length ordering and slash detection, and returns an OptionBadge TypedDict. The metavar is appended only when both spellings and metavar are nonempty. Also added parametrized tests and a CHANGES entry.
